nodes.description: Constant NFT price of 0.08 ETH used to validate payment in mint().
Constant maximum number of NFTs mintable in a single purchase (20).
Mutable maximum supply of tokens, used in mint() supply check and in calcStartingIndex() modulo.
Mutable boolean gating whether minting is allowed.
Pseudo-random starting index computed from block hash.
Block number recorded at reserve time, later used as a source of blockhash randomness.
Base URI set by the owner and used by _baseURI().
Per-token URI mapping read in tokenURI().
Owner-only function toggling saleIsActive.
Owner-only function transferring the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that safely mints a number of tokens to msg.sender and records startingIndexBlock.
Payable public mint function performing supply, purchase-limit and payment checks then looping _safeMint.
Owner-only function deriving startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock.
Owner-only fallback that sets startingIndexBlock to block.number.
Owner-only function writing the base URI.
View function resolving a token's URI from base URI and per-token URI.
Internal override returning _baseURIExtended.
Ownable owner() accessor used by the onlyOwner modifier to gate privileged functions.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, reserve recipient, withdrawal destination and ownership check.
External ETH transfer via payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance).
_safeMint call that invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, enabling a callback.
_safeMint call inside the mint loop that invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
Use of blockhash for randomness, a weak and miner-influenceable source of entropy.
Parameter of mint() controlling payment amount and loop iterations.
Parameter of reserveTokens() controlling how many tokens the owner reserves.
Parameter of setBaseURI() assigned to _baseURIExtended.
Parameter of tokenURI() selecting which token URI to resolve.
Local variable in withdraw() caching address(this).balance before transfer.
Local variable in reserveTokens() caching totalSupply() as the starting mint id.
Local variable in tokenURI() holding the per-token URI.
Local variable in tokenURI() holding the base URI.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the destination of the contract balance transfer in withdraw().
msg.sender is the recipient of reserved tokens in the owner-only reserveTokens().
msg.sender is the recipient of tokens minted in mint().
Owner identity is derived from msg.sender, and onlyOwner compares it against msg.sender.
NFT_PRICE is multiplied by numberOfTokens to validate msg.value.
require enforces numberOfTokens <= MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
require enforces totalSupply + numberOfTokens <= MAX_SUPPLY.
require(saleIsActive) gates execution of mint().
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
numberOfTokens drives the payment check and the mint loop bound.
Loop iterates up to numberOfTokens times calling _safeMint, each of which is an external callback opportunity.
withdraw() executes the external ETH transfer operation.
Local balance is forwarded to the external transfer.
reserveTokens() calls _safeMint inside its loop.
num bounds the reservation loop.
Locally cached supply seeds the token ids passed to _safeMint.
mint() calls _safeMint inside its loop.
onERC721Received invoked by _safeMint can re-enter reserveTokens before state settles.
onERC721Received invoked by _safeMint can re-enter mint() during the mint loop.
startingIndexBlock is used as the block number whose hash seeds startingIndex.
MAX_SUPPLY is the modulus applied to the block hash.
startingIndex is read and validated/overwritten in calcStartingIndex().
calcStartingIndex() writes the computed startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex() relies on blockhash for randomness.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock() writes startingIndexBlock from block.number.
reserveTokens() records startingIndexBlock on first reservation.
setBaseURI() writes _baseURIExtended.
_baseURI() reads _baseURIExtended.
baseURI_ parameter is stored by setBaseURI().
tokenURI() reads the per-token URI mapping.
tokenURI() calls _baseURI() to obtain the base.
tokenId parameter indexes _tokenURIs and is stringified.
tokenURI() assigns the mapped value to the _tokenURI local.
onlyOwner restricts flipSaleState() to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts withdraw() to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts reserveTokens() to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts calcStartingIndex() to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts emergencySetStartingIndexBlock() to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts setBaseURI() to the owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is used only inside mint() to bound payment and loop iterations.
Parameter is used only inside reserveTokens() as the loop bound.
Parameter is only assigned to a state variable inside setBaseURI().
Parameter is used only inside tokenURI() for lookup and string conversion.
Local cache of the contract balance used only inside withdraw().
Local snapshot of totalSupply() used only inside reserveTokens().
Local holding the per-token URI used only inside tokenURI().
Local holding the base URI used only inside tokenURI().
